comparison.objective: Use two sticks together as tongs to lift an unreachable cup from a fire pit.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual construction and continuous coordination of an improvised two-stick grasp.
comparison.success_condition: Cup is removed and placed upright on the target stone.
comparison.reason: It tests remote bimanual grasping with improvised tools rather than precision screw/nut adjustment and retention.
